draft.subject: Re: API pagination
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on your question from the ticket: in Wrenfield, list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you don't need to fetch everything at once. Your ticket is still open on our side, and I'm happy to go deeper on the accounts endpoint specifically.

Since the welcome call, I saw you got your first project created -- nice start. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your API setup and next steps together.

Best,
Chidi
